mapper.select: SELECT c.comment_id AS commentId, c.parent_id AS parentCommentId, c.comment_content AS commentContent, BIN_TO_UUID(c.user_id) AS userId, u.nickname AS nickname, c.comment_created_at AS createdAt FROM comment c INNER JOIN users u ON u.users_id = c.user_id WHERE c.board_id = #{boardId} ORDER BY c.comment_created_at ASC, c.comment_id ASC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT c.comment_id AS commentId, b.board_id AS boardId, b.board_title AS boardTitle, c.parent_id AS parentCommentId, c.comment_content AS commentContent, c.comment_created_at AS createdAt FROM comment c INNER JOIN board b ON b.board_id = c.board_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId, typeHandler=com.dodo.backend.common.handler.UuidTypeHandler} AND b.board_status != 'DELETED' ORDER BY c.comment_created_at DESC, c.comment_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment c INNER JOIN board b ON b.board_id = c.board_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId, typeHandler=com.dodo.backend.common.handler.UuidTypeHandler} AND b.board_status != 'DELETED'
mapper.update: UPDATE comment SET comment_content = #{commentContent}, comment_modified_at = NOW() WHERE comment_id = #{commentId}
